## What failed?

Describe expected and observed behavior. Include the Git commit and command.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest example, Python/package versions and relevant error output.
Remove credentials and personal paths. Do not upload large research artifacts.

## Scope

Is this a reporting/documentation issue or a suspected scientific defect?
For scientific issues, identify the preserved result/configuration; do not replace it.
